info.title: Go.Data API
info.description: Go.Data is WHO's outbreak investigation and contact-tracing platform. Its API is a LoopBack 3 application mounted at `/api`: every collection accepts a JSON-encoded `filter` query parameter (fields/where/include/order/offset/limit), list endpoints return bare JSON arrays, and `PUT /{collection}/{id}` patches attributes rather than replacing the record (the app sets `replaceOnPUT: false`). Authenticate with `POST /users/login` and send the returned `id` as the `access_token` query parameter or an `Authorization` header. The OpenFn `godata` adaptor reaches this API with token auth and its own list/get/upsert helpers.
